# A pennant (generated by make_env.py), origin at the staff's foot.
new
material new Staff --base-color 0.329 0.200 0.267 --no-slot
material new Cloth --base-color 0.545 0.251 0.286 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Staff --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.450
scale 0.060 0.060 0.900
apply --scale
material assign Staff
add mesh cone --name Pennant --vertices 3 --radius1 0.32 --radius2 0 --depth 0.06 --location 0 -0.38 0.78 --rotation 90 0 0
scale 0.55 1.25 1
apply --scale
material assign Cloth
select all
shade flat
export flag.glb
